responsibility: Implements GCC’s classic stabs/dbx debug writer, including the bulk of XCOFF-shared symbol-description logic. This file converts declarations, types, blocks, parameters, and source scopes into .stabs/.stabn/.stabd style symbol table entries, manages dbx type numbering and cross-reference state, emits begin/end markers for lexical blocks and functions, handles source-language and storage-class distinctions encoded in stab names and codes, and provides default constructor/destructor set emission for stabs targets.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual stabs/dbx emitter logic and XCOFF-shared symbol/type output routines, turning declarations, scopes, and types into assembler stab records. In contrast, dbxout.h only publishes the callable entry points and stab-related constants that other files use to invoke this backend.
